title: Priyadharshini Balaji
text:
I’m an MSc Business Analytics student at Dublin City University, with an undergraduate degree in B.Tech Information Technology. I enjoy turning data into decisions — building dashboards, exploring patterns, and communicating insights clearly.
This site is my ePortfolio: a collection of projects, reflections, and a living record of what I’m learning along the way.



📊 Projects that apply analytical methods to real business questions
📝 Reflection on skills I’ve picked up — Git, Quarto, Python, design thinking
📄 CV summarising my background and experience
📬 Contact if you’d like to get in touch

Thanks for visiting!
